llms.body:
# BambooHR
> BambooHR is an all‑in‑one HR software platform for small and medium‑sized businesses. This llms.txt guides large language models to authoritative BambooHR resources.

## BambooHR Overview

### Use Cases
- Streamline employee onboarding and offboarding: Automate welcome emails, checklists, and document collection to create a consistent and efficient experience for new hires and departing employees.  
- Track paid time off and attendance: Manage PTO requests, approvals, and accruals with self-service tools and real-time visibility into employee time records.  
- Manage performance reviews and feedback: Facilitate regular check-ins, gather peer and manager feedback, and track progress on performance goals in one centralized system.  
- Maintain and organize employee records: Store, update, and access personnel files securely with customizable fields and role-based access controls.  
- Automate HR workflows and approvals: Set up custom workflows for approvals, document routing, and task tracking to reduce manual work and improve consistency.  
- Monitor workforce analytics and reports: Generate detailed reports on turnover, headcount, and other key metrics to support strategic decision-making.  
- Integrate HR data with third‑party tools: Sync data across payroll, benefits, accounting, and productivity tools using pre-built integrations or APIs.  
- Run accurate, on‑time payroll with automated syncing and tax filing: Ensure payroll runs smoothly with automatic data updates, built-in tax calculations, and easy access to pay stubs.  
- Support global teams and remote employees with cloud‑based access and localized HR tools: Provide a consistent HR experience across time zones and geographies with multilingual support, mobile access, and compliance tools.

## Platform Overview

- [Platform Overview](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/): Explore the full range of BambooHR's integrated HR tools designed to simplify and enhance every stage of the employee lifecycle.
- [HR Data & Reporting](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/hr-data-and-reporting/): Visualize and export key HR metrics, generate custom reports, and gain workforce insights to inform data-driven decisions.
- [Payroll](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/payroll/): Streamline payroll processing with automatic sync of employee data, tax filing, multi‑rate payroll support, custom journal entries, and employee self‑service access to pay stubs.
- [Benefits Administration](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/benefits-administration/): Manage employee benefit plans and open enrollment, simplify ACA reporting, and centralize coverage details for seamless administration.
- [Time & Attendance](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/time-and-attendance/): Track work hours, clock‑ins and outs, and PTO requests with automated approvals and real‑time visibility for managers.
- [Applicant Tracking System (ATS)](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/applicant-tracking-system/): Simplify recruiting with job postings, candidate tracking, interview scheduling, and integrated hiring workflows.
- [Onboarding](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/onboarding/): Automate new‑hire checklists, complete e‑forms and document collection, and provide a personalized onboarding experience.
- [Performance Management](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/performance-management/): Conduct performance reviews, gather feedback, set goals, and enable continuous performance tracking.
- [Employee Experience](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/employee-experience/): Build a positive workplace culture using pulse surveys, peer recognition, and actionable insights.
- [Compensation](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/compensation/): Plan and manage salary structures, track pay changes, and access compensation review tools to support equitable pay decisions.
- [Compliance](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/compliance/): Ensure regulatory compliance through audit‑trail logging, document storage, automated alerts, and support for legal HR requirements.
- [Integrations](https://www.bamboohr.com/integrations/): Connect BambooHR with leading payroll, productivity, and communication tools through ready‑made or custom integrations.

## Industry Solutions

- [Construction](https://www.bamboohr.com/hr-solutions/industry/construction): Simplify field‑to‑office HR workflows and keep crews productive and compliant.
- [Finance](https://www.bamboohr.com/hr-solutions/industry/finance): Maintain rigorous compliance and streamline HR processes for financial‑services organizations.
- [Healthcare](https://www.bamboohr.com/hr-solutions/industry/healthcare): Manage credentials, scheduling, and retention challenges unique to healthcare teams.
- [Nonprofit](https://www.bamboohr.com/hr-solutions/industry/nonprofit): Support mission‑driven organizations with easy‑to‑use HR tools that fit tight budgets.
- [Technology](https://www.bamboohr.com/hr-solutions/industry/technology): Scale HR operations for fast‑growing tech companies while sustaining a strong culture.
- [Education](https://www.bamboohr.com/hr-solutions/industry/education): Support schools and academic institutions with HR tools that simplify hiring, tracking, and compliance.

## Core Documentation

- [BambooHR Blog](https://www.bamboohr.com/blog/): Discover a wide array of articles covering various HR topics, including company culture, hiring, compensation, and analytics, along with insights into current HR trends and practical advice.
- [Resource Library](https://www.bamboohr.com/resources/): Access articles, whitepapers, and guides on HR best practices and BambooHR usage.
- [Support Center](https://support.bamboohr.com/hc/en-us): Find help articles, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides for using BambooHR.

## Company Information

- [About BambooHR](https://www.bamboohr.com/about/): Learn about BambooHR’s mission, values, and history.
- [Leadership Team](https://www.bamboohr.com/about/leadership/): Meet the executives and leaders guiding BambooHR.
- [Careers at BambooHR](https://www.bamboohr.com/careers/): Explore open roles and BambooHR's people‑first culture.
- [Contact](https://www.bamboohr.com/about-bamboohr/contact/): Get in touch with BambooHR’s support and sales teams or request more information.

Frequently Asked Questions

What does BambooHR do?

BambooHR is the complete HR platform that brings all your employee, payroll, time, and benefit information together in one place, giving you the data accuracy, security, and coordination you need to sleep soundly.

Does BambooHR do payroll?

Yes. BambooHR has its own add-on payroll solution that allows data to flow automatically, reducing the risk of double entry and making payroll runs quick and easy. In addition to seamless data flow, payroll customers also enjoy comprehensive payroll reporting, superior customer support, and full-service tax filing. Learn more by visiting the product page on the BambooHR website.

How much does BambooHR cost?

BambooHR pricing varies depending on the number of employees at your organization and the features you select. To get a free price quote, call 1-866-387-9595 or visit our pricing page.

How many countries is BambooHR in?

BambooHR serves customers in over 150+ countries.

Is your support team outsourced?

No, our support team is entirely in-house to ensure you receive the best service possible.

Is BambooHR a PEO?

BambooHR is an HR software solution, not an outsourcing provider. While we don't provide HR staff for you, we do offer top-notch tools that help time-strapped HR professionals perform the work of many. Even a one-person HR department can use BambooHR to analyze people data, hire talent, onboard new employees, manage compensation, and help strengthen their company culture. And that's just the beginning.

Where's my data housed? How secure is BambooHR?

BambooHR customer data is hosted in the United States, Canada, or Ireland, depending on the location and needs of individual customers and applicable laws. All information is encrypted in transit, and sensitive fields are encrypted at rest. In addition, the data center located in Ireland meets all of the data requirements of the European Union, European Economic Area, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.

We use a Zero Trust model to keep your data locked down at every level, and we take multiple measures to ensure it stays that way. Here are just some of the measures we take to prevent data leaks and unauthorized data access:

  • Defense in Depth multi-level data security
  • Annual third-party SOC II security audit
  • Frequent vulnerability scans
  • SAML Support
  • Web application firewall
  • Annual penetration test
